title: Enterprise AI CI/CD, EvalOps Prompt/Model Regression Gate & Canary Rollout Architecture Selection

tiers.tier: Tier 1: 'Vibe-Check' Manual Prompt Edits & Blind Cloud Model Version Upgrades
tiers.architecture: Editing system prompts in a UI or switching model versions after manually testing 5–10 cherry-picked examples

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Brute-Force 5,000-Case Frontier LLM Judge on Every Git Pull Request
tiers.architecture: Running a 5,000-row dataset through a frontier LLM-as-a-Judge synchronously on every developer commit/PR

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Offline Golden-Set Eval Only (100% Instant Cutover in Production Without Shadow/Canary)
tiers.architecture: Passing offline CI evals, then flipping 100% of live traffic to the new prompt/model at once

tiers.tier: Tier 4: 2-Stage Tiered PR Eval Gate (`3.2m`) + AI Gateway Dark-Shadow Replay + `5%->25%->100%` Auto-Rollback Canary
tiers.architecture: Stage-1 Fast Deterministic + 200-Case Stratified Judge in PR (`3.2 min`) + Nightly 5,000-Case Full Suite + AI Gateway Async Shadow Replay + Progressive Canary with Automatic SLO Rollback (`< 30s`)

scenarios.scenario: Replacing 'Vibe-Checking 5 Prompts' with Prompt-as-Code GitOps & Deterministic Assertions
scenarios.question: A product manager tweaks a system prompt to fix one customer complaint, unintentionally breaking JSON tool calling on 36.5% of other workflows
scenarios.model_answer: Treat Prompts, Tool Schemas, and Model Configs as **Versioned Code Artifacts (`Prompt-as-Code` in Git)** gated by a **2-Stage PR Pipeline (`Promptfoo / DeepEval / Ragas / Azure AI Evaluation SDK`)**: Stage 1 runs 500 deterministic schema/regex/tool-arg assertions in `25 seconds` + a 200-case stratified semantic benchmark in `3.2 minutes` (`0.4%` regression escape vs `36.5%` vibe-check)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 manual 'vibe-checking' fixes one edge case while silently breaking three existing business flows.

scenarios.scenario: Eliminating the '54-Minute PR CI Bottleneck & $90K Eval Bill' via Two-Stage Stratified gating
scenarios.question: Running all 5,000 golden evaluation cases + GPT-4o Judge on every PR commit takes 54 minutes and costs $180 per commit
scenarios.model_answer: Split EvalOps into **Fast PR Gate (`3.2 min`, `$3.50/PR`)** and **Nightly Release Gate**: on every PR, run deterministic code assertions + a `200-case` stratified hard-negative slice using response caching; run the full `5,000-case` suite + adversarial red-teaming (`PyRIT / Garak`) on merge-to-main/nightly using 50%-off Batch API or local judge GPUs (`$26K/mo` total TCO)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 blocks developers for 54 minutes on every PR and burns $132K/mo re-evaluating unchanged cases.

scenarios.scenario: Zero-Risk Model Migration (`e.g., Model v1 -> Model v2` or `70B -> Distilled 8B`) via AI Gateway Shadow Traffic Replay
scenarios.question: Cloud provider announces deprecation of an existing model snapshot in 30 days; team is afraid to switch production traffic to the new model
scenarios.model_answer: Enable **Asynchronous Dark-Shadow Traffic Mirroring (`5%` of live read-only requests)** at the AI Gateway: the user receives the response from `Model v1` with `0ms` added latency while the gateway asynchronously replays the prompt to `Model v2` and compares latency, tool-call equivalence, and groundedness scores—certifying the migration in **12 hours (`0.5 days`)** instead of 28 days!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 takes 28 days of manual testing; Tier 3 cuts over 100% of live traffic blindly and discovers distribution-shift failures in production (`8.4%` escape).

scenarios.scenario: Progressive Canary Traffic Shifting (`5% -> 25% -> 100%`) with Automatic 30-Second SLO Rollback
scenarios.question: A new prompt + RAG chunking version passes offline evals, but triggers a 4x spike in user thumbs-down or tool retry loops on live edge-case queries
scenarios.model_answer: Roll out new prompt/model bundles via weighted AI Gateway routing (`5% -> 25% -> 100%` over 2 hours); if canary `tool_error_rate`, `P99 TTFT`, or `online_eval_groundedness` degrades by `> 2.0%` vs baseline, `Argo Rollouts / Flagger / Gateway Controller` automatically shifts 100% traffic back to the previous immutable version in **`30 seconds` (`0.5 min` MTTR)**!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 has no canary traffic splitting or automated rollback, requiring a 42-minute manual hotfix redeploy.

perturbation_checks.check: Judge Model Non-Determinism (`temperature=0` Logprob Drift Across Eval Runs)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.4% Escape (Pairwise Rubric + Reference-Anchored Deterministic Verifiers + `seed=42` Judge Calibration)

perturbation_checks.check: Continuous Production Failure Flywheel (`User Thumbs-Down / Guardrail Block` in Live Traffic)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: Auto-Anonymizes & Appends Failing Production Traces into the Stratified Hard-Negative PR Gate Weekly

key_findings: Tier 4 (2-Stage Tiered PR Eval Gate + AI Gateway Shadow Traffic Replay + 5%->25%->100% Auto-Rollback Canary) cuts production regression escapes from 36.5% ('vibe-checking') to 0.4% while keeping PR CI duration at 3.2 minutes.

Running a 5,000-case frontier LLM judge on every Git PR (Tier 2) stalls developer velocity (54 min/PR) and wastes budget; a 2-stage gate (500 deterministic checks + 200 hard-negative judge cases in PR, 5,000 cases nightly) cuts EvalOps TCO by 80.3% ($26K/mo vs $132K/mo).
AI Gateway dark-shadow traffic mirroring + automated 30-second canary rollback shrinks model version migration lead time from 28 days to 12 hours (0.5 days).
